PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.featureName: Discord identity linking to existing accounts

currentProject.evidence: dashboard.mjs loginOrRegister, web_accounts, web_sessions; dashboard-db.mjs pool. Reuse these account/session authorities; no existing external identity table in canonical auth or sql migrations.

legacyProject.reason: Archived demo is not the canonical account authority.

reuseRegistry.evidence: check-registry Discord OAuth identity auth account returns unrelated state-machine entries; no Discord OAuth implementation.

rAthena.evidence: Canonical registration and character creation use login.account_id and char.account_id, character_slots=1. No changes to those authorities.

openKore.reason: Web authentication only, no gameplay or bot behavior.

externalEcosystem.evidence: https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/oauth2 official authorization code flow and identify scope; reference only, no copied code.

genericOSS.evidence: Use existing Node crypto/fetch and mysql2; no added dependencies or replacement auth framework.

PRE_IMPLEMENTATION_REUSE_GATE.whyNotReuse: Extend existing account/session architecture with the missing provider assertion adapter and identity mapping. No provider integration exists to reuse; existing account provisioning remains password-based, so V1 supports linked accounts only.

registryUpdate.evidence: Official API contract check only, no OSS adoption candidate. Durable contract, sources and applicability are recorded here and in docs/discord-oauth-account-linking-v1.md.
